summary: Yaxing Coach (Yangzhou Yaxing Motor Coach Co., Ltd) is a bus manufacturer based in Yangzhou, Jiangsu, China. The note describes it as a subsidiary of Jiangsu Yaxing, founded in 1998. It states that buses are produced under the Yaxing, Yangtse (Yangzlv), and more recently Asiastar brands.
one_line: Yaxing Coach is a Yangzhou, Jiangsu-based bus manufacturer founded in 1998 as a subsidiary of Jiangsu Yaxing.
key_facts: Yaxing Coach's full name is Yangzhou Yaxing Motor Coach Co., Ltd.
Yaxing Coach is a bus manufacturer based in Yangzhou, Jiangsu, China.
Yaxing Coach is a subsidiary of Jiangsu Yaxing.
Yaxing Coach produces buses under the "Yaxing" brand.
Yaxing Coach produces buses under the "Yangtse（Yangzlv）" brand.
Yaxing Coach produces buses under the Asiastar brand, which the note describes as more recent.
